name: 스푸트니크의_연인
voice_summary: The voice alternates between a close first-person witness narrating retrospectively and a detached third-person observer rendering real-time events. The tone is quiet, elegiac, and ruminative — sentences unroll at a measured pace, frequently interrupted by the narrator's silent interjections or rhetorical questions directed inward. Inner monologue bleeds into dialogue transcription without clear demarcation, creating an intimacy that feels confessional. Rhythm is prose-lyrical: long, clause-stacked sentences depicting sensory dailiness are punctuated by short, declarative emotional beats. The voice never over-explains emotion; instead it catalogs concrete domestic details (sunscreen, newspapers, ferry arrivals) that carry the full emotional weight.
